checklist.title: Set up the AI Dungeon Master
checklist.intro: These steps take a campaign from no AI to a working AI DM. Each step below reads its real state and links straight to the control that changes it.
checklist.allDoneDriver: The AI holds the DM seat and acts directly — it narrates, rolls dice, applies HP and conditions, and runs the session within the budget you set. Players join at the Table tab.
checklist.allDoneCoDm: The AI is co-DMing — it only proposes, and nothing lands in canon until a human DM approves it.
checklist.unavailable: Readiness could not be loaded. Try again from campaign settings.
checklist.costTitle: Estimated cost before the next run
checklist.costBody: Plan for up to {{tokens}} tokens (about {{prompt}} prompt + {{completion}} completion). USD estimate: {{usd}}.

flag.title: Server AI enabled
flag.onAdmin: The server-wide AI switch is on. Any campaign can now use an AI DM.
flag.offAdmin: The server-wide AI switch is off. Turn it on in the AI console to allow any AI participation.
flag.askAdmin: Server-side AI is experimental and off by default. A server admin must enable it before this campaign's AI DM can run.
flag.copyRequest: Please enable experimental AI (Server admin → AI console → Server-wide AI) so I can run an AI DM in my campaign.

provider.title: AI provider configured
provider.done: A provider and API key are stored for this campaign ({{model}}).
provider.todo: Choose a provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, or the mock provider for testing) and store an API key. Test the connection before moving on.

mode.doneCoDm: Mode is Co-DM — the AI only proposes; you approve every change before it applies.
mode.doneDriver: Mode is Driver — the AI acts directly as the DM, running the session at the Table.
mode.todo: Pick how the AI participates. Co-DM (recommended) only proposes — you approve every change before it applies. Driver hands it the DM seat to act directly within the budget you set.

budget.title: Token budget set
budget.done: A hard budget of {{budget}} tokens is set. Turns stop when it is reached.
budget.todo: Set a positive token budget. It is a hard cap on spend and is required before Driver mode will run.

table.title: Players know where to play
table.driver: In Driver mode, players join the shared session at the Table tab in the sidebar. Share that with your table.
table.notYet: Once Driver mode is on, a Table tab appears for every member — that's where the session is played.

dashboard.hintBody: This campaign can run an AI co-DM (it only proposes — you approve every change) or a Driver session (the AI acts directly as the DM). A few settings turn it on.

badge.coDmAria: An AI is co-DMing this campaign — it only proposes; a human DM approves. What that means
badge.driverAria: An AI is running this campaign directly as the DM — open the Table

transparency.title: What the AI sees and does
transparency.body: The AI DM is given this campaign's summary and its session-zero charter — never any other campaign's data. If you configure an external AI provider, that context is sent to the endpoint you chose; see the AI privacy notice in provider settings for the full list and retention terms. The two modes have different authority. Co-DM asks: it only drafts proposals, and a human DM must approve every one before anything changes — the AI never writes to canon directly. Driver acts: the AI holds the DM seat and runs the session itself — narrating, rolling dice, applying HP and conditions, and resolving live play within the budget you set. Canon edits (new NPCs, quests, locations) still become proposals for DM review. In Driver mode the DM and the table can pause the AI or take the seat back at any time from the Table page.

flagDisabled.title: Server AI is turned off
flagDisabled.body: AI features are experimental and disabled server-wide. A server admin must enable them before the AI DM can run.

seatDisabled.title: The AI DM isn't switched on
seatDisabled.body: This campaign's AI DM seat is off. Choose a mode in campaign settings: Co-DM (the AI only proposes — a human DM approves every change) or Driver (the AI acts directly as the DM).

budgetExhausted.title: Token budget used up
budgetExhausted.body: The AI DM has spent its token budget. Raise the budget (or reset usage) to continue.

serverCap.title: Server AI budget reached
serverCap.body: The server-wide AI token cap has been reached. A server admin must raise it in the AI console.

needBudget.title: Driver mode needs a budget
needBudget.body: Driver mode requires a positive token budget. Set one, then switch the mode to Driver.

needProvider.title: Driver mode needs a provider
needProvider.body: Driver mode requires a configured AI provider with an API key. Set one, then switch the mode to Driver.

needModel.title: Driver mode needs an executable model
needModel.body: The selected AI model must pass the server allowlist and provider policy before Driver can run.

needDriverTools.title: Driver mode needs tool calls
needDriverTools.body: Driver mode requires a provider that supports tool/function calls so it can use Campfire tools safely.

paused.title: The AI DM is paused
paused.body: The session is paused. The DM can resume it from the Table.

humanControl.title: A human holds the seat
humanControl.body: A human has taken over the DM seat. The AI won't act until control is handed back.
